text: 像素动态星空（dsh-skin-pixel-anime）是面向 DSH 网页端的像素风主题插件。它通过主题 token 覆盖和设置页接入界面，提供五套明暗配色、四种文字配色方案、像素字体和圆角选项，并绘制星空、流星及会话标题时钟。用户可在插件设置中即时切换外观，偏好保存在浏览器本地；需要支持客户端 bundle 的 DSH 网页主机，不需 API 密钥或外部服务。

Pixel Starfield (dsh-skin-pixel-anime) themes the DSH web interface with configurable pixel palettes, text colors, fonts and corners. It adds animated stars, meteors and a conversation clock. Settings apply live and persist in browser storage. Requires a DSH web host with client bundle support.

像素动态星空的外观设置：在插件设置页选择配色、文字方案、圆角和字体，切换会即时应用并保存到浏览器。
像素动态星空的星空与流星背景：客户端绘制像素星点、旋转星带和周期性流星效果，并允许设置背景动效及流星参数。
像素动态星空的会话时钟：将像素风时钟组件注册到会话标题前部，在 DSH 网页界面中显示。
像素动态星空的界面配色：使用主题 token 覆盖改变明暗主题的颜色，并可分别调整文字层级和链接、代码区域配色。
像素动态星空使用前须知：仅声明接入 DSH web 客户端；用户选择保存在浏览器 localStorage 中。

dsh-skin-pixel-anime README · dsh-skin-pixel-anime：[中文](#功能) · A pixel dynamic starfield theme plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web UI (显示名：像素动态星空).

dsh-skin-pixel-anime README · Features：- **Pixel clock** — SVG-drawn LED readout in the conversation header, with blinking colon, sparkle, and heart. Stands down automatically if the host build already draws its own hero clock.
- **Five palettes** — Matrix / Sakura / Ocean / Sunset / Vapor, each with tuned light and dark schemes that follow the host Appearance setting.
- **Four layered text schemes** — Ink / Phosphor / Blueprint / Amber. Each one sets a full ladder of text tones (primary → secondary → tertiary → caption → dimmed) plus link, brand text, and markdown code-area colors, so headings, body, metadata, and links read at distinct depths on top of any palette.
- **Five pixel fonts + system default** — VT323, Press Start 2P, Silkscreen, Pixelify Sans, and Fusion Pixel (simplified Chinese, pixelates CJK text too). All fonts are embedded — no network requests, offline-friendly. Latin-only faces fall back to system fonts for Chinese.
- **Corner presets** — square / soft (2px) / round (8px), applied across every UI element.
- **Rotating pixel starfield** — 42 rainbow stars with LED-style stepped twinkle, plus a milky way simulated purely with stars: a tight Gaussian core band and

dsh-skin-pixel-anime README · Install：From the [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) plugin marketplace (设置 → 插件市场, recommended — installs the prebuilt tarball), or via a local-directory install (插件管理 → 本地插件目录) pointing at a clone of this repo or an unpacked release tarball.

Requires a DSH web host with client bundle support (0.1.0-rc.6+). Refresh the page after install.

dsh-skin-pixel-anime README · Structure：Hand-authored against the loader's closure-factory contract — no build step:

- `lib/index.js` — host half (marker plugin for the bundle patch row)
- `lib/client.js` — client half: token overrides, stylesheet, clock, rotating starfield, meteors, settings tab
- `cordis.patch.yml` — bundle patch row
- `OFL.txt` — license notices for the embedded fonts (all SIL OFL 1.1)
